findings.title: Late Escape frame catches up all queued ticks on resume
findings.claim: Pausing a delayed frame prevents ticks immediately, but leaves them queued; resuming runs them in a burst.
findings.why: After a 500 ms stall, Escape holds the ship at tick 0, but resuming can advance it 30 ticks in one frame. The new test ends before resume.
findings.fix: Discard the local driver's queued debt when entering pause, without changing authority code, and test a delayed Escape followed by resume.
